objective: Directly verify same-wake sustained work cadence in chat without weakening durable evidence or close authority.
acceptance_criteria: Provisional SAME MAIN schedule is live-verified, durably persisted, then one compact schedule trace is emitted.
Each bounded substantive unit completion trace occurs only after observed unit START/END/DURATION and artifact-backed work evidence are durably persisted.
After each unit trace, same-wake authorized work continues while normal CONTINUE elapsed is below 600s.
No mere read, plan, wait, retry, or scheduler-only event is mislabeled as a completed unit.
Normal close live-verifies SAME MAIN exact observed END+60, persists one consistent close projection, then emits the final next-due trace.
No duplicate substantive overlap or stale schedule rollback occurs.
checkpointable_substeps: Fresh bootstrap, policy sync, provisional live verification, durable REARM_VERIFIED, and schedule trace.
Execute bounded substantive unit; persist unit timing/evidence; emit trace; continue.
Repeat safe bounded units while below 600s, using fallback/residual work during external waits.
At or after 600s finish the smallest safe in-flight unit, checkpoint, exact END+60 rearm, durable projection, final due trace, TURN STATUS.
early_finish_fallback: If the obvious unit finishes or becomes externally wait-bound before 600s, select an independent authorized fallback/residual unit or decompose the next safe unit. Do not close merely because a trace was emitted.
